% Blue-accent CV, adapted from the Word-mirroring ChatGPT resume so it works in
% the Job Tracker CV Builder. Same visual identity (navy small-caps name, blue
% #2563EB section rules, tight margins), but sandbox-compliant and driven by the
% eight placeholders.
%
% What had to change from the ChatGPT original, and why:
%   1. \input{glyphtounicode} and \pdfgentounicode=1 removed. \input is a blocked
%      primitive (a template must not read files in the sandbox); it only
%      affects copy-paste out of the PDF, nothing visual.
%   2. \usepackage[usenames,dvipsnames]{color} removed. xcolor already provides
%      \definecolor with HTML values.
%   3. \documentclass 9pt -> 10pt. 9pt is not a real article size; LaTeX silently
%      ignores it, so stating 10pt is honest.
%   4. All personal data replaced by the nine placeholders. A template with no
%      placeholders prints the author's own CV for every user.
%   5. The 4-argument \resumeSubheading{role}{dates}{company}{city} cannot be fed
%      by the builder: Experience arrives as ONE string, one entry per line. So
%      entries render as list lines instead of two-column rows.
%   6. Sections with no placeholder (Resume summary, Projets, Langues) removed.
%      Fold that content into headline / experience / skills lines instead.
%   7. No \obeylines: the build pipeline already converts each form line into a
%      hard line break (\\{}), so one line per entry prints as one line here.

\documentclass[letterpaper,10pt]{article}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[empty]{fullpage}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage[colorlinks=true]{hyperref}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}

% Blue accent matching the Word version (#2563EB)
\definecolor{accent}{HTML}{2563EB}
\definecolor{navy}{HTML}{1F2937}
\definecolor{greytext}{HTML}{555555}

\hypersetup{
  linkcolor=accent,
  urlcolor=accent,
  citecolor=accent,
}

\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}

% Margins
\addtolength{\oddsidemargin}{-0.55in}
\addtolength{\evensidemargin}{-0.55in}
\addtolength{\textwidth}{1.1in}
\addtolength{\topmargin}{-0.6in}
\addtolength{\textheight}{1.3in}

\urlstyle{same}
\raggedright
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{0in}

% Section titles - blue small-caps with a rule, matching Word headers
\titleformat{\section}{
  \vspace{-1pt}\color{accent}\scshape\raggedright\large
}{}{0em}{}[\color{accent}\titlerule \vspace{-1pt}]
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{6pt}{4pt}

% One line per entry. The builder turns every form newline into a hard break,
% so a multi-line field prints as stacked lines inside a single \item.
\newcommand{\resumeItem}[1]{\item\small{{#1}}}
\newcommand{\resumeListStart}{\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=0.18in, label={}, itemsep=1.2pt, topsep=2.5pt, parsep=0pt]}
\newcommand{\resumeListEnd}{\end{itemize}\vspace{-2pt}}

\begin{document}

% ---------- HEADER ----------
\begin{center}
    \textbf{\Huge \scshape \color{navy} {{fullName}}} \\[3pt]
    \small \textbf{\color{accent} {{headline}}} \\[3pt]
    \footnotesize \color{greytext}
    {{email}} $\quad|\quad$ {{phone}} \\[2pt]
    {{links}}
\end{center}
\vspace{4pt}

% ---------- PROFILE ----------
\section{Profil}
\resumeListStart
  \resumeItem{ {{profile}} }
\resumeListEnd
\vspace{-2pt}

% ---------- EXPERIENCE ----------
% One line per role in the Experience field: "Role, Company (dates) - detail".
\section{Expérience}
\resumeListStart
  \resumeItem{ {{experience}} }
\resumeListEnd

% ---------- EDUCATION ----------
% One line per qualification: "Degree, School (dates)".
\section{Formation}
\resumeListStart
  \resumeItem{ {{education}} }
\resumeListEnd

% ---------- CERTIFICATES ----------
% One line per certificate: "Cert Name, Issuer (year)".
\section{Certificats}
\resumeListStart
  \resumeItem{ {{certificates}} }
\resumeListEnd

% ---------- SKILLS ----------
% One line per skill group: "Category: item, item, item".
\section{Compétences}
\resumeListStart
  \resumeItem{ {{skills}} }
\resumeListEnd

\end{document}
